deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: Your account is deactivated immediately and your personal data is permanently erased after {{days}} days.
consequences: You are signed out on every device and push notifications stop straight away.
After {{days}} days your profile, contact details, race entries' personal and medical details, GPS history, followed athletes, and notifications are erased.
Photos of you are removed from race galleries.
Race results and payment records are kept only in de-identified form where race integrity or the law requires it.
deletion.exportHint: Download a copy of your data first if you need it.
deletion.recoveryHint: Changed your mind? Until the erasure date, use "Cancel a pending account deletion" on the sign-in page with your email and password.
deletion.scheduledBody: Your account is deactivated and scheduled for erasure on {{date}}. You can still cancel before then.
deletion.scheduledBodyNoDate: Your account is deactivated and scheduled for erasure. You can still cancel before then.
deletion.successBody: Your account is deactivated and will be erased on {{date}}. You will now be signed out.
deletion.cancelFailed: We could not cancel the deletion. Please try again.
deletion.blockedTitle: Account deletion is unavailable right now

blockers.ACCOUNT_DELETION_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: You are the only active super administrator. Make another user a super administrator before deleting this account.
blockers.ACCOUNT_DELETION_ACTIVE_RACES: You are the only active organizer of a race that is open, closed for registration, or in progress. Add another race administrator, or complete or cancel the race first.

errors.ACCOUNT_DELETION_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter your password to delete your account.
errors.ACCOUNT_ALREADY_DELETED: This account has already been deleted.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
